title: Nullpoint join the pro ranks
body:
[[Nullpoint]] are officially a pro team, playing under the tag 0PT.

They earned their place through BPL Challengers Stage 2026 champion.

**The roster.** [[candybar_isblue]] (#10), [[UtsuhoNull]] (#22), [[zhizyii]] (#109), [[Kaito_Oshino]] (#163) and [[ssseiso]] (#282).

The headline name is [[candybar_isblue]], currently #10 in the league. Their first ranking points will come at their next event.

title: candybar_isblue is the new #1
body:
[[candybar_isblue]] has taken over the #1 spot in the BPL player rankings with 1792 rating points, moving past [[SanCtuary]].

[[candybar_isblue]] is a Singaporean rifler, now the top-ranked player in the league (1792 points), with a 1.10 K/D across 42 maps.

title: Laburi is the new #1
body:
[[Laburi]] has taken over the #1 spot in the BPL player rankings with 1808 rating points, moving past [[candybar_isblue]].

[[Laburi]] is a Singaporean in-game leader, now the top-ranked player in the league (1808 points), with a 1.19 K/D across 44 maps.
